![Settings, Developer: the Connect your AI panel with the Claude Code steps](/lp/guide/en/connect.webp)

Open **Settings → Developer**, pick your app, copy, paste, sign in.

```flow
Pick your app
Sign in to Genos
Choose teams and access
```

Deleting stays off unless you tick it. Revoke the app whenever you like. Core and above.
